LM_Capitol_Building.origin: rotunda centre at the south grade; front (south) faces Blender -Y

LM_Capitol_Dome.origin: rotunda centre at the south grade (same as LM_Capitol_Building)

LM_Capitol_Fence10.origin: foot of the run's start; runs 10 m along -Y; scale Y to fit a run

LM_Capitol_Grounds.origin: rotunda centre; z = 0 is the grounds' base (the city ground)

frame.local_to_plan: x = x0 + cos(phi) u - sin(phi) v,  y = y0 + sin(phi) u + cos(phi) v

conventions.units: metres in Blender/GLB; Unreal imports as centimetres
conventions.frame: Blender +X = building east, +Y = building north, origin = rotunda centre at the south grade; plan (x east, y north) = origin + R(phi) (u, v); Unreal X = plan y * 100, Y = plan x * 100
conventions.fence: LM_Capitol_Fence10 runs 10 m along its local -Y from its origin; place modules along each run, scaling Y to fit; gate piers stand at their origin; lamps at their foot
